property_summary: For every call to transfer, the reference contract always returns true (succeeds) even when _tos is non-empty and performs calls to caddress for each recipient; the mutant (which removes the require that _tos.length > 0) can make transfer succeed when _tos is empty but still must not attempt any external calls — the observable rule we use: when _tos is empty, the reference reverts (does not return) while the mutant returns true, so there exists an input (empty _tos) that makes their post-call success differ.
change_summary: Remove the require that _tos.length > 0 so transfer no longer reverts on empty _tos array.
